title: Bruhat decompositions of operator algebras
summary: We introduce and study a notion of decomposition of a C$^*$-algebra over a Coxeter system based on Tits' definition of a $W$-distance. When such a decomposition comes with suitable conditional expectations, we build an associated Fock Hilbert module and reduced C$^*$-algebra $A^r$. This unifies constructions of Voiculescu [Voi85] and Caspers--Fima [CF17] and provides a noncommutative analogue of the situation of a discrete group $G$ acting on a building, in which case $A^r \cong C^*_r(G)$.
